projects.title: Personal Portfolio Website
projects.subtitle: A premium showcase of web development skills
projects.description: A fully responsive portfolio website built with React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. Features a dark theme with smooth animations and a custom design system.
projects.solution: Implemented a responsive grid layout with mobile-first approach, using Tailwind's responsive utilities to ensure consistent design across all devices.
projects.process: 1. Wireframes and UX research 2. Component architecture 3. Design system 4. Development 5. Testing 6. Launch
projects.results: Increased website traffic by 40%, received positive feedback on design quality.

projects.title: AI Analytics Dashboard
projects.subtitle: Intelligent data visualization for portfolio analysis
projects.description: An interactive dashboard for analyzing portfolio performance with real-time charts, skill distribution, and AI-powered insights.
projects.solution: Built a React component architecture with memoized charts, lazy-loaded recharts, and smooth scrolling transitions for better performance.
projects.process: 1. Data model design 2. Chart implementation 3. Performance optimization 4. Testing
projects.results: Reduced load time by 60%, received 4.8 stars rating.
lessonsLearned: Memoization is critical for chart performance

projects.title: E-Commerce Platform
projects.subtitle: Full-featured online store with AI recommendations
projects.description: A complete e-commerce platform with product catalog, shopping cart, checkout flow, and AI-powered product recommendations.
projects.solution: Built a scalable architecture with React hooks for state management, a custom hook for cart operations, and Stripe integration for payments.
projects.process: 1. Requirements gathering 2. Architecture design 3. API development 4. Frontend development 5. Testing
lessonsLearned: Payment integrations require careful UX design

projects.title: Design System Library
projects.subtitle: A comprehensive design system for the portfolio
projects.description: A reusable design system library with 50+ components, design tokens, and a consistent UI across the entire portfolio.
projects.solution: Created a centralized design token system with color, spacing, typography, and shadow tokens. Every component is built to be consistent and accessible.
projects.process: 1. Token definition 2. Component library creation 3. Design system integration 4. Testing
projects.results: Reduced development time by 30%, improved consistency across projects.
lessonsLearned: Design tokens are essential for consistency

projects.title: Mobile App Prototype
projects.subtitle: A mobile-first portfolio application for iOS and Android
projects.description: A mobile-first portfolio application using React Native with smooth animations and intuitive navigation for mobile users.
projects.solution: Built a mobile-first application with a bottom navigation bar, swipeable tabs, and optimized performance for older devices.
projects.process: 1. UX research 2. Mobile design 3. Development 4. Testing on devices
projects.results: 4.5 star rating, 5000+ downloads, consistent UX across platforms.

projects.title: Case Study: Client Redesign
projects.subtitle: Complete website redesign for a startup
projects.description: A complete redesign of a startup's website, focusing on user experience, brand consistency, and performance optimization.
projects.solution: Redesigned the entire website with a modern UI, improved performance, and enhanced user experience. The redesign increased engagement by 45%.
projects.process: 1. Analysis 2. Redesign planning 3. Development 4. Testing 5. Deployment
projects.results: 45% increase in user engagement, 30% reduction in bounce rate.
lessonsLearned: User analysis is critical for redesign
